metrics.method: Full history 2025-09-14 to 2026-09-17 (1,509 non-service messages: 865 client, 644 ALTR). client_questions_total = client messages containing '?'. unanswered_over_24h = those with no ALTR message in the same forum topic within 24h (naive any-topic counting gives 2; the topic-aware figure is the honest one). Separately, 25 episodes where the client sent 2+ consecutive messages spanning >6h with no ALTR reply in between. Median ALTR first-response lag 5.6h, p75 9.3h, p90 19.0h. max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive ALTR messages (2026-08-01 19:09 → 2026-08-10 11:14); a 12h46m post-resignation silence closed the export. Promises = explicit ALTR commitments ('I'll send', 'we will start', 'let me check and come back') read manually across the full transcript; kept = evidence of delivery in-channel, lapsed = no delivery and no further mention.
